_comment: Plain-language descriptions of what each part of the assessment measures, kept
apart from en.json so the whole set can be read and revised in one place.
Shown in two places from one source: the (?) tooltips beside each indicator on
an organisation's page, and the table on /about.
Beside the locale files, but NOT loaded through @nuxtjs/i18n —
useIndicatorHelp imports this file directly. vue-i18n compiles every message,
and reads a bare @ as a linked-message marker and | as a plural separator, so
an ordinary edit here (an email address, an element name like reporting-org/@ref)
would fail the whole page at render. A static import means this file is safe to
edit as prose. The trade is that these strings cannot interpolate or
pluralise; none of them need to.
Keys are the ids from IATI/dashboard-tests, where each is a .feature filename.
The numbering is the framework's own: 1.x organisation, 2.x basic fields,
3.x financials, 4.x advanced fields.
Written against 'Reimagining Data Quality: A User Centric Approach - Proposal
for Consultation' v1.3 and the assertions in the .feature files. Four
indicators in that document are not yet calculated (1.5, 1.8, 3.3, 4.7); they
are described here and marked pending on /about, so the page explains the
framework rather than only the part of it that runs. Everything here is draft
and under consultation until November 2026.

indicatorName.1.5_country_strategy_or_mou: Country or sector strategy, or memorandum of understanding

componentHelp.downloadable: Every registered file could be downloaded from the organisation's server.
componentHelp.no_critical_errors: The files are valid against the IATI schema. Files that are not cannot enter the IATI Datastore.
componentHelp.no_errors: The IATI Validator reports no errors.
componentHelp.frequency: How often the organisation updates its files.
componentHelp.timeliness: How far behind the present the published data is.
componentHelp.coverage: Published spending as a share of an independent reference figure for the same period.
componentHelp.disaggregation: How many quarters a year the financial data is broken down into, over five years.
componentHelp.organisation_fields: The organisation file: strategic documents and forward budgets for the organisation as a whole.
componentHelp.basic_fields: The fields needed to identify an activity and compare it with others. Expected on almost every activity.
componentHelp.financial_fields: Commitments, disbursements and expenditure, forward budgets, and traceability.
componentHelp.advanced_fields: Fields that take more effort to publish but make the data useful to far more people. Not required for a first star.

indicatorHelp.1.1_organisation_strategy: The organisation file links to the organisation strategy.
indicatorHelp.1.2_annual_report: The organisation file links to the annual report.
indicatorHelp.1.3_allocation_policy: The organisation file links to the aid allocation policy.
indicatorHelp.1.4_procurement_policy: The organisation file links to the procurement policy.
indicatorHelp.1.5_country_strategy_or_mou: The organisation file links to a country or sector strategy, or a memorandum of understanding, for each recipient country.
indicatorHelp.1.6_audit: The organisation file links to the institutional audit report.
indicatorHelp.1.7_organisation_budget: The organisation file reports total budgets one, two and three years forward.
indicatorHelp.1.8_country_budgets: The organisation file reports total budgets by recipient country, one, two and three years forward.
indicatorHelp.2.1_reporting_organisation: Each activity reports the reporting organisation, with a valid organisation type.
indicatorHelp.2.2_iati_identifier: Each activity reports the IATI identifier, starting with the organisation's own reference.
indicatorHelp.2.3_implementing_organisation: Each activity reports the implementing organisation, with its name and a valid organisation type.
indicatorHelp.2.4_title: Each activity reports the title, of at least 10 characters.
indicatorHelp.2.5_description: Each activity reports the description, of at least 80 characters.
indicatorHelp.2.6_current_status: Each activity reports the activity status (e.g. pipeline, implementation, closed), using the standard codes.
indicatorHelp.2.7_dates: Each activity reports planned and actual start and end dates.
indicatorHelp.2.8_sector: Each activity reports the sector, using the detailed 5-digit (DAC CRS) purpose codes.
indicatorHelp.2.9_country_or_region: Each activity reports the recipient country or region, using the default (DAC) codes.
indicatorHelp.2.10_aid_type: Each activity reports the aid type (e.g. project, budget support).
indicatorHelp.2.11_flow_type: Each activity reports the flow type (e.g. ODA, other official flows).
indicatorHelp.2.12_finance_type: Each activity reports the finance type (e.g. grant, loan).
indicatorHelp.2.13_tied_status: Each activity reports the tied status (e.g. tied, untied, partially tied).
indicatorHelp.3.2_disbursements_and_expenditures: Each activity reports disbursements or expenditure.
indicatorHelp.3.3_traceability: The share of spending traceable to the partners who received it; for organisations that receive funding rather than provide it, whether the funder is identified.
indicatorHelp.3.4_project_budgets: Each activity reports forward budgets, annually and quarterly.
indicatorHelp.4.2_location: Each activity reports the sub-national location, as a point, an administrative area or a location identifier.
indicatorHelp.4.4_recipient_language: Each activity reports the title and description in an official language of the recipient country.
indicatorHelp.4.5_results: Each activity reports results (e.g. indicators, baselines, actuals).
indicatorHelp.4.7_organisation_identifiers: Organisation references are valid organisation identifiers, so the same institution can be recognised across publishers.
indicatorHelp.4.8_documents: Each activity links to its documents: budget, conditions, tender, contract, objectives, impact appraisal, evaluation and results.

indicatorNote.1.3_allocation_policy: Propose to exclude for NGOs and INGOs under the framework; note that this exclusion has not yet been implemented.
indicatorNote.1.4_procurement_policy: Propose to exclude for NGOs and INGOs under the framework; note that this exclusion has not yet been implemented.
indicatorNote.1.5_country_strategy_or_mou: Propose to exclude for NGOs and INGOs under the framework; note that this exclusion has not yet been implemented.
indicatorNote.1.6_audit: Propose to exclude for NGOs under the framework; note that this exclusion has not yet been implemented.
indicatorNote.1.7_organisation_budget: Propose to assess NGOs on the previous year rather than on forward projections under the framework; note that this distinction has not yet been implemented. Years forward are counted from the date of assessment rather than the date of the data.
indicatorNote.1.8_country_budgets: Propose to exclude for NGOs and INGOs under the framework; note that this exclusion has not yet been implemented.
indicatorNote.2.1_reporting_organisation: Not defined in detail in the proposal; the definition applied here is provisional.
indicatorNote.2.9_country_or_region: Not defined in detail in the proposal; the definition applied here is provisional.
indicatorNote.3.3_traceability: Direction follows organisation type — onward to partners for governments and foundations, back to funders for NGOs and the private sector, both for multilaterals and public-private partnerships.
indicatorNote.3.4_project_budgets: How far forward a budget reaches is counted from the date of assessment rather than the date of the data.
indicatorNote.4.6_conditions: Assessed only for activities valued at USD 100,000 or more. The threshold is provisional and subject to consultation.
indicatorNote.4.8_documents: Four of the eight document types are assessed only for activities valued at USD 100,000 or more; the threshold is provisional. The types follow those applied to government donors, and which are reasonable to expect of other organisation types remains subject to consultation.
